Metadata.title: Clara
Metadata.description: Clara — AI-native Agentic Accounting OS for Malaysian accounting firms.

Common.forbidden: Your account can't read this yet.
Common.centsUnsafe: (amount out of range — verify in the ledger)

NotFound.heading: That page does not exist
NotFound.body: Nothing is served at this address. If you followed a link inside Clara, the link is wrong — not the page.

FirmHome.heading: Firm home
FirmHome.body: The firm-altitude surfaces each have their own page in the sidebar — the Needs-you inbox, the client register, firm activity and admin. This home page carries no summary of its own yet.

NeedsYou.heading: Needs you
NeedsYou.body: Everything waiting on a person, across every client the firm serves.
NeedsYou.emptyMessage: Nothing is waiting on you across any client right now.
NeedsYou.firmQuestionsEmpty: No open firm-level questions right now.
NeedsYou.namedClientUnavailable: The client list could not be loaded — you can still resolve without naming a client.
NeedsYou.identifierPromotionsEmpty: No open identifier promotions right now.

ClientsRegister.heading: Clients
ClientsRegister.emptyMessage: No clients are visible to this firm yet.
ClientsRegister.factsUnavailableNote: Entity type and MSIC could not be loaded for this list — the client register itself is unaffected.

FirmActivity.heading: Activity
FirmActivity.body: The firm-wide receipts and open-register feed.
FirmActivity.subheading: A record of what the agent did across every client — not a queue of what awaits you. See Needs you for that.
FirmActivity.visibilityNote: Receipts are visible to bookkeeper-and-above roles. A more limited role sees an empty feed for that reason, not because nothing happened.
FirmActivity.emptyMessage: No agent activity has been recorded yet.

Admin.heading: Admin
Admin.body: P2 shell — users, capabilities and the metering rollup are built in P4. See docs/plan/active/mohe-grill-rulings-2026-08-27.md Q3.

Members.pageDescription: Everyone with access to this firm, and the invitations nobody has accepted yet.

roleOptions.viewer: Viewer — reads the books and changes nothing
roleOptions.bookkeeper: Bookkeeper — prepares and posts the day-to-day work
roleOptions.admin: Admin — manages people and invitations as well
roleOptions.owner: Owner — signs for the firm; a firm always keeps one

roster.heading: Members
roster.description: The roster is published to bookkeeper and above.
roster.empty: This firm has no members on its roster.
roster.emailNote: A withheld email has two causes and this screen does not guess between them: the column is published to admin and owner only, and a member can also have no email on record.

invites.heading: Pending invites
invites.description: Invitations are published to admin and owner only, so this list reads empty below that rank.
invites.issueBlocked: Admin or owner can invite someone

inviteDialog.title: Invite someone to this firm
inviteDialog.description: Clara emails them a single-use link. The address is how they will sign in, and it is how the invitation is checked when they accept.
inviteDialog.ceilingNote: You can invite someone at your own rank or below. The firm refuses anything higher.

removeDialog.title: Remove {name} from this firm?
removeDialog.description: They lose access immediately and any agent credentials they hold for this firm are revoked. There is no undo verb: inviting them again creates a fresh membership.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke the invitation for {email}?
revokeDialog.description: The link stops working. Revoking is also how you free this address for a fresh invitation before the current one expires.

courier.title: The invitation was not sent
courier.no_session: You are not signed in any more. Sign in and try again.
courier.cross_origin: That request did not come from this app, so it was refused.
courier.invalid_request: The invitation form sent something this server could not read.
courier.mail_not_configured: This deployment has no invitation mail set up, so nothing was created. Ask whoever runs it to configure the mail transport.
courier.mail_failed: The invitation was created but the email did not go out, and its link cannot be recovered. Revoke it below and invite again.
courier.transport: The invitation server could not be reached.

ClientWorkspace.heading: Client workspace
ClientWorkspace.body: One workspace per client. The accounting objects are tabs — journals, documents, bank, close, reports, registers and knowledge.
ClientWorkspace.notFoundMessage: No client with this id is visible to your firm.
ClientWorkspace.queueEmpty: Nothing is waiting on you for this client right now.

thread.signInRequired: Sign in to talk with Clara.
thread.streamEndedUnexpectedly: The connection to Clara ended unexpectedly.

entryPosted.title: Entry posted
entryPosted.note: The entry's lines and amount are read live on the journals workbench — this receipt carries identifiers and the ledger's own verdict, never a figure.

bankAct.title: Bank act
bankAct.note: The act's own outcome is on the ledger's receipt — open the client's Bank tab to read it live.

bankPack.title: Bank pack read
bankPack.note: The digest every bank act in this conversation had to cite. A read only — nothing in the books changed.

CommandPalette.title: Command palette
CommandPalette.description: Go to a page, ask Clara, or dispatch a run.

do.heading: Do
do.disabledLabel: Dispatch a run — not built yet

JournalsWorkbench.heading: Journals
JournalsWorkbench.noSession: Sign in to view this client's journals.
JournalsWorkbench.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Sign in again to view this client's journals.
JournalsWorkbench.forbidden: You don't have permission to view this client's journals.
JournalsWorkbench.notFound: Journals are not available for this client right now.

linesEditor.notBalanced: Debits and credits don't match yet — the DB will refuse an unbalanced entry on submit.

compose.title: New journal entry
compose.description: A manual entry — recorded via record_client_resolution + draft_entry, the DB's own manual-compose ceremony.

drafts.empty: No drafts are waiting for review.
drafts.showingOf: Showing {shown} of {total} drafts — some may be hidden behind a large backlog in another category. Narrow the queue to see the rest.
drafts.entryUnavailable: This entry could not be read — it may have changed since the queue was last loaded.
drafts.presentationSumUnavailable: Totals unavailable — too many lines to verify
drafts.linesTruncated: This client has more lines than could be safely read at once — the totals below cannot be verified and are withheld.

posted.presentationSumUnavailable: unavailable — too many lines to verify
posted.alreadyReversed: This entry has already been reversed.
posted.isReversal: This entry is itself a reversal — a reversal cannot be reversed.

ClientDocuments.heading: Documents
ClientDocuments.uploadHint: Drop files here or pick — up to 20MB each; queued 2 at a time.
ClientDocuments.uploadDuplicate: {filename} is already uploading — skipped a duplicate.
ClientDocuments.queueStopped: Stopped tracking — the document may already be stored
ClientDocuments.queueErrorFiling: Stored — filing to this client failed
ClientDocuments.queueErrorTimeout: Timed out awaiting the intake row
ClientDocuments.queueRecoveryAttemptCap: stored — not re-read (retry attempts used up)
ClientDocuments.queueRecoveryLaneBusy: stored — a read is already in progress
ClientDocuments.queueRecoveryMimeMismatchDetail: This document was stored as {stored}; it was re-sent as {sent}. Re-upload it in its original form.
ClientDocuments.candidatesEmpty: No documents are waiting on a confirmation for this client.
ClientDocuments.filedEmpty: No documents are filed to this client yet.
ClientDocuments.detailEmpty: Select a document to see its evidence, filings and doors.
ClientDocuments.documentNotReachable: This document is not reachable today.
ClientDocuments.openDocumentPopupBlocked: Your browser blocked the new tab — allow pop-ups for this site and try again.

readError.no_session: You're not signed in — sign in to see this.
readError.unauthenticated: Your session has expired — sign in again to see this.
readError.forbidden: You don't have access to this.
readError.server_error: The server had a problem reading this — try again shortly.
readError.transport: Couldn't reach the server — check your connection.
readError.malformed: Got an unreadable response from the server.

ClientDocuments.evidenceOverlayReason: A page-image overlay of these regions' locators exists only for the chat review card today — not on this tab.
ClientDocuments.entriesHeading: Journal entries filed to this client
ClientDocuments.entriesEmpty: No journal entries filed to this client cite this document yet.
ClientDocuments.adminPrivilegedNote: Legal hold and correction are privileged — a non-admin token refuses honestly.
ClientDocuments.correctionNoEntries: No cited entries — filing move only.
ClientDocuments.correctionDistinctCheckerNote: Approval needs a distinct eligible checker. A solo firm may approve with a written attestation below.
ClientDocuments.correctionAttestationPlaceholder: Attestation (only used on the solo path)

ClientBank.heading: Bank
ClientBank.body: Accounts, statements, matching and reconciliation — every figure read live from the DB.

common.forbidden: You don't have access to this.
common.notBuiltDetail: This needs {verb}, which this build does not wire a form for yet.

accounts.proposalsDescription: A statement was uploaded for a bank identity this client doesn't have on file yet.
accounts.proposalReasonUnregistered: No bank account on file for this identity yet.
accounts.proposalReasonInactive: An inactive account already exists ({account}) — reactivate it, or use this to bind a new one.
accounts.fromProposal: Confirming this will also resolve the proposal above.

statements.invalidAmount: Opening and closing balances must be a valid amount.
statements.invalidLine: Line {n} needs a date and a valid amount.

matching.invalidAllocation: Each allocation needs a valid positive amount.
matching.noAllocations: Allocate at least one open item.
matching.matchHeading: Match {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} against
matching.invalidMatchedCents: Each matched entry needs a non-zero whole-cents amount.
matching.selectLinesAndEntries: Select at least one line and one entry.
matching.unmatchHint: Find a match ID on a matched line in the Statements tab's line view, then unmatch it here.

exceptions.proposalsAttribution: Proposed by the agent — awaiting your decision.
exceptions.writeOffIncomplete: A write-off needs a posting date, a memo, a resolution note, and at least two journal lines.

reconciliation.staleHeading: Stale outstanding items — acknowledge each before completing
reconciliation.staleDetailNotBuilt: The detail leg is not built — verify each item in the statement view before acknowledging.
reconciliation.cannotCompleteHint: Not yet completable — see the blockers/stale items above.

agency.holdDescription: A brake on the bank agent's autonomous lane for this client — a bookkeeper-floor act.
agency.promotionsAttribution: Proposed by the agent — awaiting your decision.

ClientClose.heading: Close
ClientClose.body: Open a fiscal year, pick one to view its close plan — gates, doors, and the receipt/segregation record — or manage the close-prep hold and future-method attestation below. Every figure is read live from the DB.

picker.empty: No fiscal years opened yet for this client.

plan.mismatch: Close plan unavailable — the read did not match the current selection.
plan.selectPrompt: Select a fiscal year above to view its close plan.

begin.title: Begin close — {label}
begin.description: clara.begin_close — opens a close run and evaluates every gate. Needs the close_and_attest capability.

finalize.title: Finalize close
finalize.description: clara.finalize_close re-evaluates every gate in-transaction. A solo firm, or a year with no distinct human preparer, needs an explicit self-attestation — leave it blank otherwise.

abandon.title: Abandon this close run
abandon.description: clara.abandon_close reopens the fiscal year for editing without a receipt. Requires a reason.
abandon.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this close run being abandoned?

reopen.title: Reopen this closed fiscal year
reopen.description: clara.reopen_fiscal_year mirrors the closing entry as a prior-period adjustment. Needs the reopen capability, a reason (10+ characters), and a correction target. A CLR05 refusal (no_eligible_human / attestation_required / distinct_checker / self_attestation) names exactly who may act — try again with an attestation if it asks for one.
reopen.attestationLabel: Attestation (only if a refusal named it)

gates.heading: Close gates
gates.empty: No gate measurements yet — begin the close to evaluate them.

attest.title: Attest this gate exception
attest.description: clara.attest_close_exception — the existing audited attest door (0056). One click records one attestation, bound to the gate's current measurement.

receipt.heading: Close receipt & segregation
receipt.absent: No close receipt yet for this fiscal year.

proposal.heading: Clara proposes close
proposal.noRun: No close run yet for this fiscal year — a proposal cannot exist until one begins.
proposal.empty: No close proposal from Clara yet for this run.
proposal.drafted: {count, plural, =1 {1 drafted item} other {# drafted items}}

adopt.title: Adopt this close proposal
adopt.description: clara.settle_close_proposal — adopts Clara's proposal. Refuses unless every drafted item already carries a live agent-authored attestation on this run.
adopt.basisDrafted: {count, plural, =1 {covers 1 drafted item} other {covers # drafted items}}

withdraw.title: Withdraw this close proposal
withdraw.description: clara.settle_close_proposal — declines Clara's proposal. Requires a reason.
withdraw.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this proposal being declined?

opener.fyEndUnset: FY end not set (defaults to 31 Dec)

setFyEnd.title: Set the client's fiscal-year end
setFyEnd.description: clara.set_client_fy_end — refuses while a live ANNUAL-cadence adjustment template or depreciation authority stands (retire it first).

open.title: Open a fiscal year
open.description: clara.open_fiscal_year — the first-ever trigger for this door in the product. One click opens ONE new fiscal year for this client.
open.previewFallback: No fiscal-year end set yet — defaults to {endsOn}.
open.lengthReasonLabel: Length reason (refused without one — this year is not ~12 months)

closePrep.heading: Close-prep hold
closePrep.notHeld: No close-prep hold is visible here.

hold.title: Hold close prep
hold.description: clara.hold_close_prep — pauses the close-prep lane for this client. Requires a reason.
hold.reasonPlaceholder: Why is close prep being held?

release.title: Release the close-prep hold
release.description: clara.release_close_prep — resumes the close-prep lane. Requires a reason.
release.reasonPlaceholder: Why is the hold being released?

futureAttestation.heading: SST future-method attestation
futureAttestation.title: Record a future-method attestation
futureAttestation.description: clara.record_future_attestation — human-attested only (never inferred). service_group is validated server-side against the live SST threshold schedule.

receipts.heading: Agent act receipts
receipts.empty: No agent act receipts yet for this client.

ClientReports.heading: Reports
ClientReports.body: Statutory close reports (sealed, archived) and the analysis sandbox (watermarked, requested through Clara) — every figure and every custody fact is read live from the DB.

statutory.heading: Statutory close reports
statutory.subheading: The signed-original archive (0127) — sealed, never watermarked.
statutory.notDeployed: The reporting engine is not deployed in this environment yet.
statutory.empty: No report artifacts yet for this client.
statutory.noDownload: No byte-download door exists yet — copy the storage key and retrieve the file through ops tooling. A signed-URL download route is a named follow-up, not built in this pass.
statutory.byteSizeInvalid: Byte size must be a whole number of bytes (digits only).

issue.title: Issue this pack for approval
issue.description: clara.approve_report_for_issue — the one human act that closes the pre_sign chain. Names the sealed hash shown below, never recomputed.

archive.title: Archive the signed original
archive.description: clara.archive_signed_original — the wet-signed pack's own identity, bound to the pre-sign hash it answers.

retrieve.none: No signed original archived yet for this run.

receipts.heading: Agent receipts
receipts.empty: No agent-act receipts yet for this client.

sandbox.heading: Analysis sandbox
sandbox.subheading: Watermarked, never sealed (0132) — structurally unreachable by the seal chain.
sandbox.requestNotice: There is no human "request export" door — the mint/request verbs are granted to Clara's agent lane only. Ask Clara, in the rail, to build a sandbox view or request an export.
sandbox.empty: No sandbox exports yet touching this client.

register.title: Register an export recipient
register.description: clara.register_export_recipient — admin only. Firm-member recipients only in this form (an external recipient's covered-clients form is a named follow-up).

freeform.heading: Freeform reads
freeform.subheading: The audited "ask the books" read log (0131) — a history, not a query box.
freeform.runNotice: There is no human "run a freeform read" door — wake_freeform_read is Clara's agent lane. This is a read-only history of what Clara has read.
freeform.empty: No freeform reads yet naming this client, and no firm-wide reads either.

ClientRegisters.heading: Registers
ClientRegisters.body: AR/AP aging, fixed assets, adjustments, staff advances and accounts — every figure read live from the DB.

aging.empty: No open items as of today.

fixedAssets.empty: No fixed assets recorded for this client.

adjustments.emptyTemplates: No recurring adjustment templates for this client.
adjustments.emptyRuns: No adjustment runs recorded for this client.
adjustments.name: Name

staffAdvances.empty: No staff advances recorded for this client.

accounts.heading: Chart of accounts
accounts.empty: No accounts in this client's chart of accounts yet.
accounts.name: Name

ClientKnowledge.heading: Knowledge
ClientKnowledge.body: Durable facts recorded about this client.
ClientKnowledge.subheading: Durable facts recorded about this client — each with who recorded it, on what basis, and when. A document-attached evidence library lives on the Documents tab, not here.
ClientKnowledge.empty: No facts have been recorded for this client yet.

Login.title: Sign in
Login.description: Sign in to your Clara account.

Logout.failed: Sign-out didn't complete. Please try again.

Invite.confirmDescription: This link can only be used once. Continue when you're ready to set your password.
Invite.errorDescription: It may have expired or already been used. Ask whoever invited you to send a new one.
Invite.verificationIncomplete: This invite could not be confirmed. Ask whoever invited you to send a new one.
Invite.subjectMismatch: This browser is signed in as a different account. Sign out first, then open your invite link again.
Invite.setPasswordDescription: Your invite is confirmed. Choose a password to finish setting up your account.
Invite.refusalTitle: Your invitation could not be completed
Invite.linkIncompleteDescription: It's missing the part that identifies your invitation, so it can't be used here. If you've already finished setting up your account, sign in from the login page. Otherwise, ask whoever invited you to send a new link.
Invite.unconfirmedDescription: Your invitation went through, but we couldn't confirm your access to the firm just now. Check again, or sign in from the login page.

OpeningCarryDown.heading: Opening balances & carry-down
OpeningCarryDown.noSeedYet: No opening seed has been created for this client yet.
OpeningCarryDown.noPlanNote: This client has no onboarding plan yet — an opening seed cannot be created until one exists.

openingPosition.firstYearZero: No opening seed needed — this client's opening position was recorded as zero at onboarding (a first-year, first-trading client).
openingPosition.chaseListTitle: Still needed before this client's opening can be keyed
openingPosition.notBuiltNote: The FY1 basis-of-preparation cost figure and the close-seal block while this banner is up are not built on this surface yet.

seed.heading: Opening seed
seed.createDescription: Starts the carry-down lifecycle for this client — draft items, tie out, then approve.
seed.keyedNote: Leave the seed untied for a keyed carry-down; a document-tied seed is created from the document's own extraction, not this dialog.
seed.cancelDescription: Only an empty open seed (no drafted items) can be cancelled.
seed.reopenDescription: Reopens a finalized seed for a further batch of items.
seed.notSerializableHint: Approval must run in a serializable transaction — the deploy ceremony sets this in the DB.

dryrun.heading: Tie-out
dryrun.ties: Ties — the opening-balance-equity net is zero.

items.heading: Drafted opening items
items.draftDescription: One item at a time — the dry-run tie-out reflects every drafted item before you approve the batch.
items.keyedResolutionRequired: Mint the keyed resolution below first — an untied seed's items require it.

itemFields.signedAmountHint: Positive is the natural equity (credit) polarity; negative is debit.
itemFields.presentationOnly: Presentation sum only — the door computes the authoritative net.

supersede.title: Supersede "{key}"
supersede.description: Reverses this item on the finalized seed and reopens it for a correction batch.
supersede.reversalOnlyNote: This drafts a reversal only — draft a fresh replacement item afterward if one is needed, then approve the correction.
supersede.fixedAssetReplacementRequired: A fixed-asset item cannot be superseded by a plain reversal — the DB requires a replacement baseline this dialog does not author. Draft a fresh asset via "Seed a fixed asset" after reopening the seed instead.

keyed.resolutionBound: A keyed resolution is bound to this seed.
keyed.mintResolutionDescription: The human keyed door — always open. Every keyed opening item's provenance binds to this record.
keyed.addTargetDescription: One line at a time; exactly one of debit/credit must be positive.

fixedAsset.title: Seed a fixed asset's opening baseline
fixedAsset.description: Mints a pending register row that activates when this batch is approved.
fixedAsset.keyedResolutionRequired: Mint the keyed resolution first — an untied seed's fixed assets require it.

approve.approveDescription: Finalizes every drafted item in this batch — runs at serializable isolation.
approve.planRevisionMissing: The onboarding plan could not be re-read — try again.
approve.draftCountNote: {count, plural, =0 {No draft items} one {# draft item} other {# draft items}} in this batch.
approve.attestationHint: Required only if you both last-edited and are approving with no distinct checker available.
approve.approveCorrectionDescription: Finalizes the seed's own correction drafts — runs at serializable isolation.

FixedAssetsDepreciation.chartAccountsLoading: Loading the chart of accounts — the Complete/Dispose account pickers need this to finish before they can be confirmed.

actions.completeDescription: This sets the depreciation method once — a later correction goes through Revise, which is prospective and leaves history charged so far intact.
actions.reviseDescription: Mints a new register row effective from the date below; the current row is superseded. Cannot take effect on or before a period already charged.
actions.disposeDescription: Books the disposal entry — stub depreciation through the disposal month, cost/accumulated relief, proceeds and any gain or loss.
actions.proceedsAccountLabel: Proceeds account (leave blank if proceeds are RM0)
actions.costPortionHint: Leave blank to dispose the whole asset.
actions.disposalDraftOutstandingRow: A disposal is already drafted (entry {entryId}) — approve or withdraw it before raising another.

profiles.heading: Account profiles
profiles.subheading: The (cost, accumulated, expense) account triple new assets on this cost account bake in.
profiles.empty: No fixed-asset account profiles enrolled yet.
profiles.upsertTitle: Enrol or update an account profile
profiles.upsertDescription: Leave the accumulated and expense accounts both blank for a non-depreciable profile (e.g. land).
profiles.retireDescription: This does not free the account for any register row that already carries it — those rows keep the codes they were born with.

tie.heading: Register / GL tie-out
tie.subheading: Whether the fixed-asset register agrees with the general ledger, as of today.
tie.tied: The register ties to the GL.
tie.broken: The register does NOT tie to the GL — see the account breakdown below.
tie.pendingDraftNote: {count} row(s) sit behind an unposted opening draft, excluded from both sides.

authority.heading: Depreciation authority
authority.subheading: The cadence Clara is authorised to run scheduled depreciation on.
authority.none: No depreciation authority has been proposed for this client yet.
authority.rampEarned: Autopost ramp earned — a reviewed run has posted under this authority.
authority.rampNotEarned: Autopost ramp not yet earned — the next run posts as a draft.
authority.fyEndFallback: No fiscal year end is on file for this client — defaulting to 31 December.
authority.proposeDescription: An admin must sign this before any period can be run.
authority.signDescription: Signing is admin-only — the autopost ramp derives from this signature.
authority.retireDescription: Stops the period being proposed. Reason is required.

runs.heading: Depreciation runs
runs.runDescription: The period must exactly match the live authority's own cadence window, and must have already ended.
runs.runNoop: Nothing was due for this period — no entry was posted.

linesEditor.notBalanced: Debits and credits do not balance yet — the DB will refuse an unbalanced entry.

proposeTemplate.title: Propose a recurring adjustment template
proposeTemplate.description: An admin must sign this before it can run. Lines are the template's own recipe — every occurrence posts them unchanged.
proposeTemplate.autoReverseLabel: Auto-reverse each occurrence at the start of the next period
proposeTemplate.memoHint: The memo every occurrence carries — required, since it is the only description a scheduled run posts with.

signTemplate.title: Sign "{name}"
signTemplate.description: Signing is admin-only. This re-checks the template's dates are still the first/last day of a period under the client's CURRENT fiscal year — a stale window refuses rather than posting on the wrong dates.

retireTemplate.title: Retire "{name}"
retireTemplate.description: Stops the template being run. A reason is required. Refused while an occurrence draft for this template is still outstanding — approve or withdraw it first.

runDue.due: An adjustment run is due for {start} – {end}.
runDue.nothingDue: No adjustment run is due right now.
runDue.allBlocked: Every live template's next period is blocked — see the run history below.

runHistory.heading: Run history
runHistory.subheading: Every adjustment run, with its own correction affordance where the DB says one applies.
runHistory.empty: No adjustment runs recorded for this client.
runHistory.pairInFlight: A pair reversal is already in flight ({status}) — see the ledger below.
runHistory.soloOccurrenceNote: This run is a solo occurrence, not an auto-reverse pair — correct it from the Journals tab.
runHistory.unavailable: Could not load run history — see the error above.

runNow.title: Run an adjustment manually
runNow.description: The period must exactly match the live template's own cadence window, and must have already ended.
runNow.noLiveTemplates: No live templates yet — sign one above first.

reversePair.title: Reverse this adjustment pair
reversePair.description: Mints two draft corrections (one per half of the auto-reverse pair) for a distinct checker to approve or cancel below — this does not post anything itself.

pairLedger.heading: Pair-reversal ledger
pairLedger.unavailable: Could not load the pair-reversal ledger — see the error above.
pairLedger.empty: No pair reversals raised for this client.

approvePair.title: Approve this pair reversal
approvePair.description: A distinct checker act — the DB re-derives both corrections are byte-exact leg-swaps of the halves they reverse before approving either.

cancelPair.title: Cancel this pair reversal
cancelPair.description: Withdraws both draft corrections. A reason is required. Only possible while both halves are still drafts.

upsertAccount.description: Create or update a row in this client's chart of accounts. Confirming ALWAYS leaves the account active — editing a currently-inactive account reactivates it.
upsertAccount.reactivateHint: This account is currently inactive — confirming this edit reactivates it.
upsertAccount.specialHint: These five slots are usually provisioned at onboarding — only change one if you know it needs correcting.

StaffAdvances.tieOk: The register ties to the general ledger.
StaffAdvances.tieMismatch: The register does not tie to the general ledger for at least one account — see the statement below to trace the difference.
StaffAdvances.applicationDrafted: Application drafted (entry {entry}) — it is high-stakes, so it was left as a draft for a distinct checker to approve, not posted automatically.
StaffAdvances.noEnrolments: No staff-advance accounts enrolled for this client yet.

linesEditor.notBalanced: Debits and credits do not balance yet — the DB will refuse an unbalanced entry.

allocationsEditor.noOutstanding: No outstanding advances to allocate against for this client.

bookApplication.title: Book a staff-advance application
bookApplication.description: Record a payroll deduction, bank return or claim against one or more outstanding staff advances. The entry lines and the register allocations are recorded together in one governed call.
bookApplication.allocatedSummary: {amount} allocated to outstanding advances (presentation sum only)

completeParticulars.title: Complete this advance's particulars
completeParticulars.description: Purpose and reference are recorded together, once — the register is append-only and does not allow a later edit.

enrolAccount.title: Enrol a staff-advance account
enrolAccount.description: Enrolment is a supervisory act: it decides what this account means for every future entry. Choose an active, asset-typed, non-control chart account dedicated to ONE person.
enrolAccount.noCandidateAccounts: No active, asset-typed, non-control accounts are available on this client's chart — add one on the Chart of accounts tab first.
enrolAccount.attestationHint: Who this account is for, and whether the balance is a related-party balance. A sole proprietor's own draws are EQUITY, never a staff advance — do not enrol a proprietor's account here.
enrolAccount.confirmDedicatedLabel: I confirm this account is dedicated to this one person only.

retireAccount.title: Retire {account}
retireAccount.description: Retiring closes this enrolment. Every advance on the account must already be settled — the DB refuses while any balance remains outstanding.
retireAccount.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this enrolment being retired?

statement.noAccounts: No enrolled accounts yet — enrol one above to see its statement.
statement.selectPrompt: Select an account to see its statement.
statement.empty: No movement recorded for this account in the selected range.

entryDiff.noSourceDocument: A document-sourced comparison isn't available for this entry.
entryDiff.docDiffEmpty: No comparable fields were found on the source document.
entryDiff.revisionsEmpty: This draft has never been revised.

withdraw.title: Withdraw this draft
withdraw.description: Abandons the draft entirely (clara.withdraw_draft) — distinct from reversing a posted entry. A reason is required.

interruptions.firmWideNote: Firm-wide — not filtered to this client (clarifications carry no client scope).
interruptions.questionOpaque: Clara is asking for a clarification.

documentExtract.maxCharsNote: Budgeted to {maxChars} characters — the same budget the agent reads under.
documentExtract.noExtractions: No completed extraction for this document.
documentExtract.notAvailable: This document's extraction text isn't available for this client.

reextraction.title: Request re-extraction
reextraction.description: Re-queues this document for a fresh extraction attempt (clara.request_reextraction). A reason is required — this changes the evidence a posted entry may rest on.
reextraction.reasonPlaceholder: Why does this document need to be re-extracted (required)…
reextraction.outcomeReused: An extraction was already in flight for this lane — reused.

admission.receipt_backfill: First extraction for a pre-existing receipt
admission.filed_bootstrap: First extraction for an already-filed document

consentEvidence.title: Classify as consent evidence
consentEvidence.description: Marks this document as the client's cross-border-transfer consent evidence (clara.classify_consent_evidence_document). Owner-level action — the DB refuses honestly if your session doesn't hold it. A reason is required.
consentEvidence.reasonPlaceholder: Why this document is the client's consent evidence (required)…

autodraft.title: Request autodraft
autodraft.description: Asks Clara to draft a journal entry from this filing (clara.request_autodraft) — a one-click admission; the agent still runs under the same coding-lane and budget walls as the unattended sweep.

outcome.admitted: Admitted — Clara will draft this filing.
outcome.re_admitted: Re-admitted after the earlier attempt didn't complete.
outcome.re_admitted_after_withdrawal: Re-admitted — the earlier draft was withdrawn.
outcome.noop_existing: Already in progress — nothing new was queued.
outcome.already_done: Already drafted — nothing new was queued.
outcome.skipped_direction: Not queued — the sales-invoice lane isn't open for this firm yet.
outcome.refused_budget: Not queued — today's autodraft budget is used up.
outcome.refused_attempts: Not queued — this filing has already used its autodraft attempts.
outcome.lane_changed: Not queued — this filing isn't in a ready coding lane right now.

CodingQuestionsSignals.panelDescription: Filings still awaiting a posted entry, open coding tasks awaiting a decision, and open quality-lint findings for this client.

uncodedFiling.heading: Uncoded filings
uncodedFiling.laneEmpty: Nothing in this lane right now.
uncodedFiling.openTaskReasonLabel: Why does this need a coding task?
uncodedFiling.openTaskReasonPlaceholder: e.g. vendor could not be matched automatically…
uncodedFiling.askQuestionTitle: Ask a question about this document
uncodedFiling.askQuestionPlaceholder: e.g. Which account should this be coded to?

reasons.open_draft: A draft entry already exists for this filing.
reasons.already_coded: Already posted to an approved entry.
reasons.facts_pending: Extraction facts are not ready yet.
reasons.multi_doc: Spans multiple source documents — needs manual review.
reasons.tier_a_fails: The extracted facts are not yet corroborated.
reasons.direction_unresolved: Could not determine whether this is a purchase or a sale.
reasons.customer_name_missing: No customer name could be read from the document.
reasons.vendor_unresolved: No matching vendor could be found.
reasons.vendor_ambiguous: The vendor match is ambiguous and needs a human decision.
reasons.customer_ambiguous: The customer match is ambiguous and needs a human decision.
reasons.vendor_bound: Bound to a known vendor via its registration number.
reasons.binding_ambiguous: Multiple vendor bindings matched — needs a human decision.
reasons.open_question: An open question is already blocking this filing.
reasons.no_consent: This client has no active data-processing consent on file.
reasons.parked: A prior autodraft attempt was parked.
reasons.rule_backed: A coding rule already exists for this vendor.
reasons.high_stakes: The amount is above this firm's high-stakes threshold.
reasons.near_duplicate: Looks like a near-duplicate of an already-posted entry.

codingTask.heading: Open coding tasks
codingTask.empty: No open coding tasks for this client.
codingTask.completeDescription: Point this task at the approved journal entry it produced.
codingTask.loadingEntries: Loading approved entries for this filing…
codingTask.noApprovedEntries: No approved entry exists yet for this filing — post one first, then come back to complete this task.
codingTask.dismissReasonPlaceholder: e.g. duplicate task, already handled elsewhere…

lintFinding.heading: Open quality-lint findings
lintFinding.empty: No open lint findings for this client.
lintFinding.notePlaceholder: What was found, and what was done about it…
lintFinding.detailNotReachable: This finding's detail could not be read.

sweep.heading: Sweep runs
sweep.openRun: A sweep run is currently open.
sweep.noOpenRun: No sweep run is currently open.
sweep.acknowledgeGap: Acknowledging a finalized sweep run needs its run id, which only arrives via Clara's own sweep-receipt message in a thread — not built yet here. Ruled: it ships as a rich card on that message in the P6 wire bump, not a separate control on this panel.

agentTasks.heading: Running agent tasks
agentTasks.note: Tasks the agent is currently queued, held, running, or awaiting your input on — cancellable here. Already-finished work is in the activity log below.
agentTasks.empty: No running agent tasks right now.
agentTasks.cancelDescription: A running task aborts and settles; a queued or held task is cancelled immediately.
agentTasks.cancelRequestedNote: Cancel already requested — the task is still settling.

openQuestion.detailNotReachable: This question's detail could not be read.

promoteClarify.dialogTitle: Promote this clarification to a durable question
promoteClarify.dialogDescription: Turns Clara's own clarification into a durable question on this client's own record, visible on the client's Needs-you queue — distinct from a firm-level question.

ArApCounterparty.heading: Counterparty hygiene
ArApCounterparty.empty: No counterparties recorded yet for this client.
ArApCounterparty.aliasListNotBuilt: A counterparty's existing aliases and the retire-alias action are not available yet — this build has no read for them. Adding a new alias still works.

create.title: Create a counterparty
create.description: Mints a new counterparty for this client. If one already exists at this name or registration number, the door returns the existing party rather than creating a duplicate.

retireAlias.title: Retire alias "{alias}"
retireAlias.description: The alias stops matching new activity. It stays in the record as history.

merge.title: Merge — {name}
merge.consequence: Merging retires the party that does not survive, for good — there is no un-merge door. The exact effect is listed on the next step, once you name the other party.
merge.roleThisSurvives: {name} survives — the other party merges into it
merge.noCandidates: No other live counterparty of this kind exists yet to merge with.

mergePreview.title: What each side carries
mergePreview.consequence: Read directly from the database — nothing here is computed by this screen.
mergePreview.whatChanges1: {merged} is marked merged into {survivor} and retired — this cannot be undone.
mergePreview.whatChanges2: From now on, new activity naming {merged} attributes to and reads as {survivor}'s.
mergePreview.whatChanges3: {merged}'s own live coding rule (if any) retires; a replacement is proposed on {survivor} only if {survivor} does not already have one of that kind.
mergePreview.whatChanges4: {merged}'s existing open items and its own outstanding balance stay recorded under {merged} until settled — this merge does not move them.
mergePreview.whatChanges5: Aliases are not shown here — this build has no read for them.

statement.heading: Statement — {name} · {from} to {to}
statement.empty: No movement in this counterparty's statement for this period.
statement.redirectedNote: {merged} was merged into {survivor}; this is {survivor}'s own statement.
statement.redirectedNoteUnknownName: {merged} was merged into another counterparty (id {survivorId}); this is that party's own statement — its name could not be read.
statement.label: Label
statement.noApplications: No item applications recorded for this counterparty.

applyOpenItems.title: Apply one open item to another
applyOpenItems.description: Applies a credit (e.g. a credit note) against an outstanding claim (e.g. an invoice), with no movement of cash and no GL entry. Both items must already belong to this counterparty.
applyOpenItems.noCandidateItems: This counterparty needs at least two currently-outstanding open items before one can be applied to another.

unallocateGroup.title: Unallocate this application
unallocateGroup.description: Reverses the WHOLE application as one act — never a single row inside it.

snapshots.heading: Month snapshots
snapshots.subheading: clara.period_snapshots — a frozen management-accounts dataset per completed month.
snapshots.empty: No snapshots minted yet for this client.

mint.title: Mint a month snapshot
mint.description: clara.mint_month_snapshot — the month must already be complete; re-minting an already-snapshotted month is a legitimate re-snapshot, not an error.
mint.monthHint: Pick any day in the month — only the month itself is sent.

renderJobs.heading: Render job queue
renderJobs.subheading: clara.render_jobs — only a failed job can be requeued.
renderJobs.empty: No render jobs yet for this client.

requeue.title: Requeue this render job
requeue.description: clara.requeue_render_job — names the incident this successor answers.
requeue.driftTitle: The re-derived request differs from the one that failed
requeue.driftBody: Something this render depends on moved since the failure — a verified answer, a published template, a resolved layout. The DB refused a verbatim retry; requeuing again will re-derive from today's state and may render a DIFFERENT document from the one that failed. The full comparison lives in the audit trail.
requeue.driftAcknowledge: I understand this may render a different document — requeue anyway

seeding.heading: Seeding batches
seeding.subheading: clara.seeding_batches / clara.seeding_proposals — coding-seed proposals extracted from a source document.
seeding.empty: No seeding batches yet for this client.

completeBatch.title: Complete this seeding batch
completeBatch.description: clara.complete_seeding_batch — records the batch's final tick/decline/refuse counts.

tick.title: Tick this proposal
tick.description: clara.tick_seeding_proposal — accepts the proposal, birthing or binding the counterparty it names.

wiki.heading: Wiki pages
wiki.subheading: clara.wiki_pages — treatment notes, vendor rules and period context Clara has recorded for this client.
wiki.editNotice: There is no human door to author or edit a page's content — wiki_page_versions is written by the seeding-tick projection and by Clara's own agent lane. This surface curates (retires) pages only.
wiki.empty: No wiki pages yet for this client.

retire.title: Retire this wiki page
retire.description: clara.retire_wiki_page — the page's content stays in its version history; it stops being live.

compliance.heading: Compliance register
compliance.pageDescription: Every SST-registration watch across the firm that has not yet been resolved.
compliance.staleEvaluator: The compliance evaluator has not completed a run in the last 48 hours — these figures may be out of date.
compliance.empty: No open compliance watches for this firm.
compliance.clientNamesUnavailable: Client names could not be loaded — the client column below shows raw ids
compliance.centsUnsafe: (amount out of range — verify in the ledger)

vendorBindings.pageDescription: Propose, sign and revoke a vendor's identity binding. Signing requires an admin who did not propose it — the person who proposed a binding cannot also sign it; let Clara propose it, or add a second admin.
vendorBindings.noClientSelected: Select a client to see its vendor identity bindings.
vendorBindings.heading: Vendor identity bindings
vendorBindings.empty: No vendor identity bindings for this client yet.
vendorBindings.evidenceLine: {evidence} evidence entr{evidence, plural, one {y} other {ies}} · {resolutions} resolution{resolutions, plural, one {} other {s}} · {divergences} divergence{divergences, plural, one {} other {s}} (30d)
vendorBindings.signDescription: Signing makes this binding LIVE — future invoices from this vendor auto-bind to the counterparty it names. Requires an admin who did not propose this binding; the person who proposed it cannot also sign it — let Clara propose it, or add a second admin.
vendorBindings.revokeDescription: Revoking ends auto-binding for this vendor immediately. A reason is required.
vendorBindings.proposeDescription: The DB derives the binding's own fingerprint from at least three recent approved entries for this vendor — this dialog only names which counterparty to bind.
vendorBindings.counterpartyNoneYet: No eligible vendors for this client yet

sharing.shareTitle: Share this conversation with the firm
sharing.shareDescription: Every member of your firm will be able to read this conversation. This cannot be undone from here.

item.alreadySettled: This item is no longer pending — its own state above is the record.
item.planNotOpen: The onboarding plan is no longer open — nothing more can be resolved on it.

card.clientNotVisible: This client isn't visible to your session.
card.heading: Client onboarding
card.noPlanBootstrapEligible: This client has no onboarding plan yet — it was activated before this plan type existed.
card.bootstrapDescription: Creates the carry-down plan this pre-existing active client never received. The client's status is not changed.
card.noPlanNotEligible: This client has no onboarding plan, and its status ({status}) isn't eligible for bootstrapping.
card.committedNote: This onboarding plan was committed on {at}. The client is active.
card.noItems: This plan has no items yet.
card.commitDescription: This activates {client} and closes the plan ({completed} of {total} items settled). The client can then be worked in its own workspace.

commitBlocked.plan_not_open: This plan is no longer open — it cannot be committed again.
commitBlocked.client_not_onboarding: This client's status is no longer "onboarding".
commitBlocked.questions_unresolved: A required item is still pending — resolve it before committing.
commitBlocked.opening_position_required: An opening position is required before activation — settle or defer it first.

card.attestationLabel: Attestation (only needed if the DB asks for one)
card.attestationPlaceholder: Only fill this in if a commit attempt asks for an attestation.
card.cancelDescription: This archives {client}. A client record is never deleted — cancelling is the only way to undo an onboarding started in error.
card.cancelReasonPlaceholder: Why is this onboarding being cancelled?
card.cancelBlockedNotOpen: This plan is no longer open — there is nothing left to cancel.
card.beginDescription: Creates a new client record and its onboarding plan.
